evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Directive act performed as a settled operational rule — 'from now on' ratifies the cadence as load-bearing, not merely proposed.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Creed-like maxim stated as bedrock identity-level conviction — the matched-opposition form ('not rehearsed / do not actually have') performs permanence, not a moveable claim.
Restates the settled cadence as a committed operational parameter — a performed ratification of the decision, not an argument for it.
Performed declarative assigning ownership — ratification language that settles accountability as load-bearing.

mints.name: UnrehearsedIsUnowned
mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the conviction here performed as a creed-like maxim that treats rehearsal as constitutive of possession, rather than as a moveable argument?
